name: Thoughts In Color
source:
Thoughts In Color is a serious game about a session between a psychologist and their patient, Audrey Rainbow. Take on the role of the psychologist to learn about Audrey's daily life and the symptoms that she's felt throughout her life, and try to figure out what her condition is.

[From [url=https://inesinacio.itch.io/thoughts-in-color]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Thoughts In Color》是一款以心理咨询过程为题材的严肃游戏，讲述心理咨询师与来访者奥德丽·雷恩博的一次会谈。你将扮演咨询师，了解奥德丽的日常生活，以及她一直以来经历的症状，尝试弄清她的状况。

[摘自[url=https://inesinacio.itch.io/thoughts-in-color]Itch.io[/url]]
